seo.description_paragraph: Phillyda is a beautiful and unique Greek name with a rich history and cultural significance. Derived from the Greek word phyllon, which means 'leaf', the name Phillyda means 'lover of horses'. In Greek mythology, Phillydus is the name of a hero who loved horses so much that he was transformed into a horse. Despite its ancient origins, Phillyda remains a popular name today in the Christian community due to its strong association with the divine horse Arion.
